title: Rainy Harbor Scene
description: A weathered pink wooden building with a tattered sail hanging from the balcony overlooks a stormy sea where two sailing ships are visible, one prominently displaying 'NIHIL' on its sail. The wet balcony floor is covered with scattered books, an old lantern, wooden crates, and a white and yellow plumeria flower.
prompt: A detailed realistic painting of a dilapidated pink wooden building on a stormy tropical coast during heavy rain, with a large torn sail hanging from the balcony, wet wooden planks scattered with old books, an antique lantern, wooden crates, and a single white plumeria flower, two sailing ships on the rough sea in the background with one displaying NIHIL on its sail, dramatic overcast sky with palm trees on a distant shore
